citations.quote: Jensen’s alpha is the intercept of the regression equation in the CAPM and is in effect the excess return adjusted for systematic risk.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CAPM-regression appraisal family: Jensen's alpha (intercept), Treynor and modified-Treynor reward ratios, the appraisal (Treynor-Black) and modified-Jensen ratios, bull/bear betas, and Fama selectivity/diversification/net-selectivity decomposition.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Regression Appraisal: Jensen's Alpha and the Treynor Ratio
